sections.title: MID MS VALLEY
sections.text: WATER VAPOR LOOPS SHOW A PROGRESSIVE SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER MN/IA DIGGING SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD INTO THE MID MS VALLEY. A CLUSTER OF REMNANT SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS OVER EASTERN IA/MO AND WESTERN IL WILL CONTINUE TO TRACK SOUTHWARD...LEAVING A CORRIDOR OF AFTERNOON HEATING ALONG ITS WESTERN FLANK. THIS REGION APPEARS MOST LIKELY FOR CONVECTIVE INITIATION BY MID AFTERNOON. DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S AND MODERATELY STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL YIELD MLCAPE VALUES OF 1000-1500 J/KG WITH A RATHER WEAK CAP. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SHOW STRONG MID/UPPER LEVEL FLOW AND FAVORABLE EFFECTIVE SHEAR PROFILES FOR SUPERCELLS. LOW LEVEL WINDS WILL ALSO BE FAVORABLE FOR ISOLATED TORNADOES LATER TODAY ALONG A CORRIDOR ALONG THE MS RIVER INCLUDING THE STL AREA. HAVE ADDED AN ENH RISK AREA WHERE A MULTI-MODEL CONSENSUS SUGGESTS THE HIGHEST RISK OF SEVERE STORMS. STORMS MAY CONGEAL INTO A SOUTHWARD-MOVING SQUALL LINE AFTER DARK WITH AN CONTINUED RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS.

sections.title: AZ
sections.text: THERMODYNAMIC PARAMETERS REMAIN FAVORABLE FOR STORM-SCALE SEVERE DOWNBURSTS OVER THE LOWER DESSERTS OF AZ THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. WEAK EASTERLY FLOW ALOFT AND NEBULOUS FORCING MECHANISMS LIMIT CONFIDENCE ON COVERAGE OF SEVERE STORM...BUT WILL MAINTAIN THE ONGOING SLGT RISK AREA AT THIS TIME.

sections.title: ORE
sections.text: A SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS CURRENTLY TRACK NORTHWARD ACROSS NORTHERN CA TOWARD ORE. SEVERAL MODEL SOLUTIONS SUGGEST A CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS WILL FORM LATE THIS AFTERNOON OR THIS EVENING OVER SOUTH-CENTRAL ORE AND TRACK QUICKLY NORTHWARD. OTHER STORMS MAY FORM OVER THE HIGHER PLATEAUS EXTENDING SOUTHWARD INTO NORTHEAST CA AND NORTHWEST NV. GUSTY/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE IN THE STRONGEST STORMS.

sections.title: CO
sections.text: A FEW STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE OVER THE HIGH PLAINS OF EASTERN CO LATER THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. FORECAST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST SUFFICIENT FLOW ALOFT...STEEP LAPSE RATES...AND MID LEVEL CAPE FOR ISOLATED HIGH-BASED STORMS PRODUCING GUSTY/DAMAGING WINDS. ..HART/SCHNEIDER.. 06/28/2015

sections.title: PRIMARY CHANGES TO THE DAY-1 CONVECTIVE OUTLOOK
sections.text: /1/ TORNADO PROBABILITIES HAVE BEEN INCREASED TO 10 PERCENT ACROSS PORTIONS OF EASTERN MISSOURI AND WESTERN ILLINOIS INCLUDING SAINT LOUIS AND SURROUNDING AREAS. CONFIDENCE IS INCREASING IN THE RISK FOR TORNADIC SUPERCELLS ADVANCING SEWD/SSEWD ACROSS THIS AREA. SFC OBSERVATIONS AND VWP DATA SUGGEST THAT THIS REGION FEATURES OPTIMAL OVERLAP OF MODEST SFC-BASED BUOYANCY WITH MODIFYING OUTFLOW...AND LONG/LOOPING HODOGRAPHS SUBSTANTIALLY INCREASING LOW-LEVEL SRH...FOR TORNADO POTENTIAL. FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS...PLEASE REFERENCE MCD 1219. CORRESPONDING MODIFICATIONS TO THE ENH AREA HAVE BEEN MADE. /2/ THE MS-VALLEY MRGL AREA HAS BEEN EXTENDED NWD ACROSS PARTS OF THE UPPER MS VALLEY FOR AN ISOLATED SVR-HAIL RISK WITH CONVECTION SPREADING SSEWD FROM ERN MN IN THE DEEP-NWLY-FLOW PATTERN FAVORING MODEST VERTICAL SHEAR. /3/ MRGL AREAS HAVE BEEN CONNECTED BETWEEN THE SWRN CONUS AND THE SRN PLAINS VICINITY...WHERE AMPLE SUB-CLOUD EVAPORATION WILL LOCALLY BOLSTER THE SVR-WIND RISK ON AN ISOLATED BASIS.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: NO OTHER SUBSTANTIAL CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE ONGOING FORECAST. THE RISK FOR SVR WIND GUSTS CONTINUES ACROSS PARTS OF THE WRN STATES...INCLUDING PARTS OF AZ WHERE SLGT DELINEATION CONTINUES FOR THE PHOENIX METRO AND SURROUNDING AREAS. PLEASE REFERENCE MCD 1220 FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS. ALSO...ISOLATED SVR WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS PARTS OF ORE...AS MODERATE DEEP SHEAR AND DEEP INVERTED-VEE THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES FOSTER AN ENVIRONMENT FAVORING ISOLATED SUSTAINED CONVECTION WITH STRONG OUTFLOW WINDS. THIS MAY CREATE ORGANIZED BLOWING DUST SURGES -- SUBSTANTIALLY REDUCING VISIBILITIES. THE LACK OF STRONGER DEEP ASCENT IN THESE AREAS LIMITS CONFIDENCE IN A GREATER-COVERAGE SVR RISK. ..COHEN.. 06/28/2015 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1130 AM CDT SUN JUN 28 2015/

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A FEW SUPERCELLS ARE EXPECTED TO DEVELOP IN THE 20-21Z TIME FRAME FROM CNTRL MO INTO WRN IL. TORNADOES AND LARGE HAIL ARE EXPECTED. THE ST. LOUIS AREA IS IN THE HIGHEST THREAT CORRIDOR.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A WELL-DEFINED SHORTWAVE TROUGH CONTINUES TO MOVE SWD ACROSS THE MID MS VALLEY WITH SURFACE LOW OVER CNTRL IA AT 18Z. SURFACE OBSERVATIONS INDICATE A WIND SHIFT EXTENDING SWWD FROM THE LOW...WITH AN EFFECTIVE WARM FRONT/OUTFLOW NEAR THE MS RIVER IN ASSOCIATION WITH AN ONGOING AREA OF SHOWERS AND STORMS. VISIBLE IMAGERY SHOWS STRONG HEATING AND MIXING HAS COMMENCED UPSTREAM OF THE AREA...WITH A PLUME OF STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES FROM KS INTO WRN MO. MODIFIED FORECAST SOUNDINGS INDICATE LITTLE CIN REMAINING AS TEMPERATURES RISE INTO THE MID 80S F. AS THE SURFACE LOW TRAVELS SEWD...LOW-LEVEL WINDS JUST AHEAD OF IT WILL REMAIN BACKED...WITH A ZONE OF ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL SHEAR ALONG THE RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. THE STRONG FORCING FOR ASCENT COUPLED WITH FAVORABLY VEERING WIND SHEAR PROFILES WITH HEIGHT WILL STRONGLY FAVOR SUPERCELLS...AND A FEW TORNADOES ARE ANTICIPATED. ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO INITIATE NEAR THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...WITH STORMS MATURING AS THEY TRAVEL SEWD. OTHER CELLS WILL FORM LATER IN THE AFTERNOON ALONG THE ADVANCING WIND SHIFT WITH A HAIL AND TORNADO THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTION DEVELOPING ALONG HIGHER TERRAIN EAST OF TUCSON AND ALONG RIM. POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR STRONG CONVECTIVE WIND GUSTS AS STORM OUTFLOWS MERGE AND DEVELOP WESTWARD.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION IS DEVELOPING SLIGHTLY EARLIER THAN NORMAL ALONG THE HIGH TERRAIN EAST OF TUS AND ALONG RIM IN ENVIRONMENT CHARACTERIZED BY GENERAL EASTERLY MID LEVEL FLOW OF APPROXIMATELY 20 KTS AS INDICATED IN 1830 UTC EMX VWP...1.40IN TPW IN 1200 UTC TUS SOUNDING...MESO ANALYSIS ESTIMATED MUCAPE AOA 1000J/KG AND DCAPE AOA 1200 J/KG. COMPARISON OF 1200 UTC SOUNDINGS AT TUS FROM TODAY AND YESTERDAY YIELD SIMILAR THERMODYNAMIC AND WIND PROFILES SUGGESTING CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW GENERATED WIND THREAT POTENTIAL SIMILAR IN SCOPE. UNCERTAINTY IN DETAILS OF CONVECTIVE MAKE FORECAST OF EXACT EVOLUTION OF OUTFLOWS PROBLEMATIC AT THIS STAGE. CONDITIONS ARE BEING MONITORED...BUT A CONVECTIVE WATCH IS NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AT LEAST ISOLATED SEVERE WIND AND HAIL ARE LIKELY TO DEVELOP LATE THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS SERN KS...AND PERHAPS FAR NERN OK AND INTO SWRN MO.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE SHOWS TCU CONGREGATED NEAR A LOW PRESSURE TROUGH WHERE VERY STRONG HEATING HAS ERODED CIN. DEWPOINTS HAVE MIXED INTO THE UPPER 50S TO LOWER 60S WITH AROUND 1000-1500 J/KG MUCAPE PRESENT AND LCLS AROUND 700 MB. ABOVE THIS WELL-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER...WINDS ALOFT INCREASE WITH HEIGHT OUT OF THE NW. THIS SHOULD AID IN MOVING STORMS IN A SEWD DIRECTION OVER TIME. SIGNIFICANT OUTFLOW PRODUCTION IS LIKELY...WITH LOCALIZED SEVERE WINDS. SMALL HAIL LADEN DOWNDRAFTS WILL ALSO ADD TO WIND POTENTIAL. GIVEN THE RELATIVELY FOCUSED AREA AND MARGINAL THREAT...A WATCH MAY NOT BE REQUIRED BUT TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SUPERCELLS APPEAR IMMINENT WITH TORNADOES POSSIBLY DEVELOPING BY 21-22Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR TRENDS SHOW CELLS RAPIDLY DEVELOPING ON THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY OVER NERN MO...FROM KNOX COUNTY SEWD. THIS AREA IS AN ENVIRONMENT CONSISTING OF AROUND 300 M2/S2 EFFECTIVE SRH ALONG WITH A SLIGHTLY SHELTERED/MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER AND PLUME OF LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES FEEDING INTO THE AREA. AIR TO THE E OF THE KNOX COUNTY CELL IS A BIT COOL...BUT THE BOUNDARY COULD MOVE EWD. STILL...THE MOST LIKELY SCENARIO IS FOR THESE CELLS TO SLOW DOWN AS THEY TAKE ROOT INTO THE BOUNDARY LAYER...THEN TURN/PROPAGATE SEWD ALONG THE BOUNDARY WITH A TORNADO THREAT. OTHER CELLS THAT CONTINUE MOVING IN A RELATIVELY LEFTWARD DIRECTION MAY STILL YIELD A HAIL THREAT FARTHER E. ..JEWELL.. 06/28/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: LOCALIZED SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL MIGHT ACCOMPANY ISOLATED TSTMS EVOLVING N FROM S-CNTRL/SERN ORE THROUGH ABOUT 03Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED ACROSS PARTS OF LAKE AND HARNEY COUNTIES LIKELY AIDED BY WEAK MID-LEVEL HEIGHT FALLS DOWNSTREAM OF A SHORTWAVE TROUGH JUST OFF THE NRN CA COAST. THIS CORRIDOR IS PROBABLY ON THE PERIPHERY OF MODERATE AND UNIDIRECTIONAL MID/UPPER-LEVEL SLYS BASED ON EXTRAPOLATED RGX VWP DATA AND GIVEN THE HEIGHT GRADIENT BETWEEN THE TROUGH AND STOUT ANTICYCLONE ANCHORED OVER THE ERN GREAT BASIN. THESE TSTMS SHOULD PROGRESS NWD TOWARDS THE COLUMBIA RIVER INTO EARLY EVENING PRIOR TO INCREASING MLCIN. WITHIN A VERY DEEPLY MIXED AIR MASS CHARACTERIZED BY SURFACE DEW POINT DEPRESSIONS OF 40-60 DEG F AND GPS PW VALUES OF 1-1.25 IN...ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL MAY OCCUR.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SCATTERED STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY WILL GRADUALLY OVERSPREAD AREAS IN AND AROUND THE GREATER ST. LOUIS METROPOLITAN REGION THROUGH 01-02Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NUMEROUS...SOMEWHAT SMALL...BUT VIGOROUS...THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED DURING THE PAST FEW HOURS ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL AND NORTHEAST MISSOURI...AND ADJACENT PORTIONS OF THE MIDDLE MISSISSIPPI VALLEY. THIS IS BEING AIDED BY FORCING FOR ASCENT ACCOMPANYING ONE OF AT LEAST A COUPLE OF DIGGING SHORT WAVE IMPULSES WITHIN CYCLONIC NORTHWESTERLY MID/UPPER FLOW. ACTIVITY HAS INITIATED IN A MODERATELY UNSTABLE BOUNDARY LAYER THAT APPEARS CHARACTERIZED BY CAPE ON THE ORDER OF 2000 J/KG... BUT AT LEAST ACROSS THE ST. LOUIS METRO AND AREAS TO THE NORTHEAST...THE TENDENCY WILL BE FOR ACTIVITY TO PROPAGATE INTO A SOMEWHAT COOLER AND LESS UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT. INTERFERENCE FROM OTHER STORMS COULD ALSO BE A LIMITING FACTOR TO OVERALL STORM SUSTENANCE. IT REMAINS UNCLEAR WHETHER FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH AN AN AREA OF WEAK LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION OVERSPREADING THE REGION WILL BE STRONG ENOUGH TO SUPPORT CONSOLIDATION AND UPSCALE GROWTH OF CONVECTION. DESPITE THESE POTENTIAL NEGATIVE FACTORS...THERE STILL APPEARS A WINDOW OF OPPORTUNITY THROUGH AROUND 01-02Z...FOR AT LEAST A COUPLE OF STORMS TO EMERGE WITH AT LEAST SOME INCREASE IN SEVERE WEATHER POTENTIAL. THIS WILL INCLUDE THE RISK FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALIZED STRONG WIND GUSTS. PERHAPS OF MORE CONCERN...20-30 KT SOUTHWESTERLY 850 MB FLOW WILL CONTINUE TO CONTRIBUTE TO SUFFICIENTLY LARGE LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS TO SUPPORT THE RISK FOR AT LEAST RELATIVELY SHORT-LIVED TORNADOES WITH ANY OF THE POTENTIALLY STRONGER EMERGING STORMS THROUGH EARLY EVENING. ..KERR.. 06/28/2015 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY CONTINUE TO ACCOMPANY ISOLATED TSTMS THROUGH ABOUT SUNSET.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SPORADIC TSTM DEVELOPMENT HAS OCCURRED WITHIN A PLUME OF GENERALLY LOWER TO MIDDLE 50S SURFACE DEW POINTS AND LIGHT UPSLOPE FLOW REGIME ACROSS THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. AREA VWP DATA CONFIRM MID-LEVEL WINDS OF ONLY AROUND 20-30 KT...WITH THE BULK OF STRONGER N/NWLYS CONFINED TO THE LOWER PLAINS. NEVERTHELESS...THE PRESENCE OF A HIGH-LEVEL SPEED MAX IN CONJUNCTION WITH STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES APPEARS TO FAVOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL IN THE STRONGEST UPDRAFTS. THIS RISK SHOULD DIMINISH AFTER SUNSET OWING TO THE LACK OF GREATER LARGE-SCALE ASCENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TORNADO WATCH 367 MAY BE EXTENDED IN AREA/TIME LOCALLY. OTHERWISE...A NEW WATCH ISSUANCE IS NOT EXPECTED. SEVERE THUNDERSTORM WATCH 368 WILL ALSO BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT ITS 06Z EXPIRATION...IF IT IS NOT CANCELLED EARLIER.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ALTHOUGH NOT CLEAR...IT IS POSSIBLE THAT ISOLATED STORM INTENSIFICATION ACROSS THE ST. LOUIS METRO WAS SUPPORTED BY ENHANCEMENT OF UPWARD VERTICAL MOTION ASSOCIATED WITH A MID-LEVEL SPEED MAXIMUM. NEW MODEL GUIDANCE IS SUGGESTIVE THAT THIS FORCING WILL CONTINUE TO SPREAD EAST SOUTHEASTWARD...ROUGHLY ALONG THE INTERSTATE 64 CORRIDOR...INTO SOUTHERN ILLINOIS THROUGH 04-06Z. IN GENERAL...THOUGH...VIGOROUS THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT HAS BECOME INCREASINGLY SPARSE IN COVERAGE ALONG AND AHEAD OF AN ASSOCIATED WIND SHIFT EXTENDING SOUTHWESTWARD THROUGH SOUTHERN MISSOURI AND SOUTHERN KANSAS. PEAK CONVECTIVE INTENSITIES HAVE ALSO BEEN TRANSITIONING DOWNWARD IN WEAKER /AND WANING/ BOUNDARY LAYER INSTABILITY. THESE GENERAL TRENDS ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE INTO THE OVERNIGHT HOURS.
